question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Idle
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Idle"** means not active, not in use, or without purpose. (निष्क्रिय)

 
 
• **Example: **The factory remained idle due to a lack of raw materials.
 
 
 
• **"Active" **refers to being engaged in action, movement, or participation. It indicates energy and involvement. (सक्रिय)
 
 
• **Example: **She leads an active lifestyle, participating in sports and outdoor activities.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Idle' **is **'Active'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rude **(असभ्य): Showing a lack of respect or courtesy.

 
 
• **Example:** His rude comments offended everyone at the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Brave **(साहसी): Showing courage and a willingness to face danger or challenges.
 
 
• **Example: **The brave firefighter rescued the child from the burning building.
 
 
 
• **Lucky** (भाग्यशाली): Having good fortune or success by chance.
 
 
• **Example:** She was lucky to win the lottery on her first attempt.
